test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Sound made by a horse
solution:
The correct answer is "**neigh**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neigh** means the **prolonged cry made by a horse**.

 
 
• **Example:** *The horse **neighed** for water.*
 
 
 
• Therefore neigh is the appropriate answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bray** - cry of a donkey.

 
 
• **Example:** *The donkey's **bray** was irritating.*
 
 
 
• **Bark** - sound of a dog.
 
 
• **Example:** *The dog **barked** loudly for its bone. *
 
 
 
• **Growl** - a low throat noise to show anger, usually made by a dog. 
 
 
• **Example:** *The dog **growled** at the thief.*
